description: What the permissions suite must notice about the approval of edit_file with several edits: the owner must be shown every edit in order, told how many there are and how many are not shown, and a call of several edits must not be approved as one.

mutations.name: A1
mutations.what: the approval lists every edit, not only the first 20, and the combined view does not say how many are left out

mutations.name: A2
mutations.what: the combined view does not number the edits

mutations.name: A3
mutations.what: the approval does not say how many edits there are

patches.old: kind: 'edit', path: input.path, replace_all: false, edit_count: edits.length,

mutations.name: A4
mutations.what: a call with several edits is approved as one edit (only old_string and new_string of a single edit are shown)

mutations.name: A5
mutations.what: the summary of a call with several edits does not say how many
